mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.user_verification_code (phone, code, purpose, used, expired_at, used_at) VALUES (#{phone}, #{code}, #{purpose}, #{used}, #{expiredAt}, #{usedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE NC.user_verification_code SET used = 1, used_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND used = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NC.user_verification_code WHERE expired_at <= NOW()
